descriptors.concept_name: Accounting by a Non-Joint-Control Party in a Joint Operation
descriptors.definition: A party participating in a joint operation without holding joint control accounts for its interest based on whether it possesses rights to the assets and obligations for the liabilities. If it holds such rights and obligations, it applies the requirements of a joint operator.
inclusion: Parties participating in a joint operation without joint control
exclusion: Parties holding joint control over the arrangement
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from joint operators who possess joint control and direct rights to assets and obligations.

descriptors.definition: Joint venturers recognize their interest in a joint venture as an investment and apply the equity method in consolidated statements. Separate financial statements account for these interests in accordance with specific separate financial statement standards.
inclusion: Joint venturers recognizing investments in joint ventures
exclusion: Joint operations where parties hold direct rights to assets and liabilities
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from joint operations which require recognizing specific shares of assets and liabilities rather than a net investment.

descriptors.concept_name: Accounting in the Consolidated Financial Statements for Joint Ventures
descriptors.definition: A joint venturer recognizes its interest in a joint venture as an investment in its consolidated financial statements. This investment is accounted for using the equity method unless specific standard exemptions apply.
inclusion: Consolidated financial statement recognition of joint venture interests
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from separate financial statements which follow separate measurement rules.

descriptors.concept_name: Accounting in the Separate Financial Statements for Joint Ventures
descriptors.definition: In its separate financial statements, a joint venturer accounts for its interest in a joint venture following the designated separate financial statement standard requirements. These rules govern how the entity records its investment independently of group consolidation.
inclusion: Separate financial statement entries for joint venture interests
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from consolidated reporting which mandates the equity method.

descriptors.concept_name: Accounting by a Non-Joint-Control Party in a Joint Venture
descriptors.definition: A party participating in a joint venture without joint control evaluates its level of influence to determine the applicable accounting standard. If significant influence is present, it applies financial instrument or equity standards accordingly.
inclusion: Parties participating in joint ventures without joint control
exclusion: Parties holding active joint control over the arrangement
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from joint venturers who possess joint control and must use the equity method.

descriptors.concept_name: Accounting for Acquisitions of Interests in Joint Operations
descriptors.definition: When an entity acquires an interest in a joint operation constituting a business, it applies business combination accounting principles to the extent of its share. This includes measuring identifiable assets and liabilities at fair value and recognizing resulting goodwill.
inclusion: Acquisitions of interests in joint operations constituting a business
Formation of joint operations involving contributed businesses
exclusion: Formations where parties only contribute assets or asset groups that do not constitute businesses
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished from simple asset acquisitions by the application of full business combination rules when a business is present.

descriptors.concept_name: Significant Differences Between Ind AS 111 and AS 27
descriptors.definition: Ind AS 111 redefines joint ventures into joint operations and joint ventures based on rights and obligations rather than structural categories used in older standards. Furthermore, it mandates the equity method for joint ventures, replacing the proportionate consolidation method.
inclusion: Comparative classifications and accounting treatments between Ind AS 111 and AS 27
nearby_distinctions: Distinguished by the replacement of AS 27 proportionate consolidation with Ind AS 111 equity accounting for joint ventures.
